meta.name: WealthSmith Semantic Z-Index Tokens
meta.description: Semantic z-index tokens map primitive stacking values to product UI meaning. Components should use these tokens instead of raw z-index numbers.

raised.description: Raised page content such as active cards or elevated sections

sticky.description: Sticky page headers and sticky section headers

primary.description: Primary app navigation and desktop sidebar

dropdown.description: Dropdown menus, select menus, and autocomplete panels

tooltip.description: Tooltips and small contextual help bubbles

scrim.description: Overlay scrim or backdrop behind drawers, sheets, and modals

drawer.description: Drawer, side sheet, and temporary overlay panel

modal.description: Modal, dialog, confirmation, and blocking overlay surface

panel.description: Smith AI side panel or overlay panel

floatingTrigger.description: Floating Smith AI trigger or helper button

toast.description: Toast notifications and transient feedback messages

criticalAlert.description: Highest-priority critical alert or system message
